text_block_list.text:
Before training, Neo Universe visited
the planetarium.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We will now begin the screening of 'Soar into the Galaxy.'
To avoid disturbing other guests during the film,
please refrain from talking."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“‘A vast band of space to which the Solar System belongs...
...The Milky Way Galaxy. Let us visit the planets that exist within it—’”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... this waveform... is fluctuating...
'Gliese'... like the guidance of gravity.
...It's projecting onto the astral hieroglyph—)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. ...Earth... is so small.
I wonder if... I can send it from here.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hello, this is Neo Universe.
I took a small step... forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This concludes our program.
Thank you very much for watching.
The next screening is scheduled in two hours—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Voyager.
I want to experience... other planets too...

And so, Neo Universe stayed to watch
the next showing as well.
As a result, she ended up skipping training.
